output.why: The evidence strongly points to a resource performance issue. Cartservice has severe memory pressure (87% of a very low 48Mi limit) and significant CPU throttling (13.9%), causing probe failures and preventing the pod from becoming ready. The resource constraints are preventing the service from responding to health checks, resulting in zero traffic and impacting downstream services like checkoutservice which shows elevated latency.
